_comment: Every launch parameter for one client, in one place. Feeds
Fields set to null are deliberately unset and MUST be filled before launch.
optimization_goal_value in particular has to come from the advertiser --
platform rules forbid us pre-filling it from a default, an industry average,
or another client's campaign. The builder refuses to run while it is null.

strategy._comment: ONE strategy. Two overlapping ones bid against each other, split the learning signal, and make attribution between them unreadable.
strategy.name: OKC Metro - Homeowner + Distress Signals
strategy._counties_note: Tulsa 40143 (273,288) is expansion, not their stated footprint. Add only on client confirmation.
strategy._demographics_note: Max 2 groups. Income + net worth uses both; adding language is rejected by the platform.

measurement._tv_number_note: Static, appears nowhere else, baked into the creative. Unattributable by nature -- counted in the phone system only. Decide BEFORE the video edit is locked.
